title: Prologis Acquires 3.2M SF Logistics Portfolio in Inland Empire
summary: Prologis expands Southern California footprint with major industrial portfolio acquisition valued at $680 million.
content: Prologis, Inc. (NYSE: PLD) today announced the acquisition of a 12-building, 3.2 million square foot logistics portfolio located in the Inland Empire region of Southern California for approximately $680 million. The portfolio is 97% leased to a diverse mix of e-commerce and third-party logistics tenants. The acquisition strengthens Prologis' position in one of the most supply-constrained industrial markets in the United States. 'This acquisition exemplifies our disciplined approach to portfolio enhancement in high-barrier markets,' said Hamid Moghadam, Co-founder and CEO of Prologis.

title: Prologis Reports Q4 2023 Earnings: Revenue Up 12% Year-Over-Year
summary: Strong quarterly performance driven by record leasing activity and 68% net effective rent change on new leases.
content: Prologis reported fourth quarter 2023 revenues of $1.93 billion, a 12.4% increase compared to Q4 2022. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $698 million, or $0.95 per diluted share. Core Funds from Operations (Core FFO) was $1.26 per diluted share. The company achieved record net effective rent change of 68% on new and renewal leases signed during the quarter. Global occupancy was 97.6% at quarter end. Full-year 2023 revenues reached $7.95 billion.

title: Prologis Announces $2B Sustainability-Linked Bond Offering
summary: Green bond proceeds will fund renewable energy and sustainable building initiatives across the global portfolio.
content: Prologis priced a $2.0 billion dual-tranche sustainability-linked bond offering comprising $1.0 billion of 10-year notes at 5.10% and $1.0 billion of 30-year notes at 5.45%. Net proceeds will be used to fund projects consistent with the company's Green Finance Framework, including solar installations across 200 million square feet of rooftop and LED lighting retrofit programs targeting a 50% reduction in energy intensity by 2025.

title: Prologis and Amazon Renew 15M SF Logistics Partnership
summary: Long-term lease renewal covering 65 facilities in 24 markets strengthens Prologis' largest tenant relationship.
content: Prologis announced a long-term lease renewal with Amazon covering approximately 15 million square feet across 65 facilities in 24 markets. The agreement includes rental escalations aligned with market rates and a commitment to develop an additional 5 million square feet of new build-to-suit logistics facilities over the next three years. Amazon remains Prologis' largest customer representing approximately 6% of net effective rent.

title: Prologis Expands European Presence with €500M Germany Acquisition
summary: Six-property portfolio near Frankfurt and Munich logistics corridors acquired at 99% occupancy.
content: Prologis completed the acquisition of a six-property logistics portfolio in Germany totaling approximately 2.1 million square feet for €500 million. Properties are located in key distribution corridors near Frankfurt Airport and Munich, with average lease terms of 7.2 years and a weighted average occupancy rate of 99%. This acquisition increases Prologis' European AUM to over $35 billion.

title: Prologis Q1 2024 Earnings: Occupancy at 97.4%, Guidance Raised
summary: Record occupancy and 54% rent change on new leases support raised full-year Core FFO guidance of $5.42-$5.50 per share.
content: Prologis reported first quarter 2024 revenues of $1.96 billion, up 10.2% year-over-year. Global occupancy reached 97.4%. The company raised its 2024 Core FFO guidance to $5.42-$5.50 per diluted share, reflecting continued strong demand from e-commerce, retail, and manufacturing tenants across all major markets. Development starts of $0.6 billion reflected selective deployment in high-conviction markets.

title: Prologis Launches 500MW Solar Program Across US Portfolio
summary: Largest industrial rooftop solar program in the US targets 500 megawatts of generation capacity by 2025.
content: Prologis announced the launch of its 500-megawatt rooftop solar program across its US portfolio. The program will install solar panels on more than 500 buildings in key markets including California, New Jersey, and Texas. Expected annual energy generation of 700 GWh will power the equivalent of 65,000 homes. The initiative is expected to generate over $50 million in annual revenue through power purchase agreements.

title: Prologis Acquires Duke Realty for $26B, Creating Largest US Industrial REIT
summary: Transformational merger adds 153 million SF to Prologis portfolio, cementing dominant US market position.
content: Prologis completed its acquisition of Duke Realty Corporation in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $26 billion. The merger adds approximately 153 million square feet of high-quality logistics real estate in 19 major US markets. The combined company owns and manages approximately one billion square feet globally, strengthening Prologis' position as the world's largest owner of logistics real estate.
